data.name: Baidyanath
data.gender_notes: Baidyanath is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Baidyanath is a revered name in Hindu mythology, derived from the Sanskrit words 'Baidya' meaning healer and 'Nath' meaning master or lord. This name is traditionally given to a boy, signifying the belief that the child will grow up to be a healer or a wise guide. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is known as Baidyanath, the lord of healing.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of healing and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Baidyanath belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Baidya (healer).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baidyanath total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
